en: Though I am but a humble knight at present, I have sworn to do all that I can to become a storied hero of whom my family can be proud.
Not quite. History has a habit of repeating itself. Should the current wave of suspicion and conflict continue to rise...
...then there'll be another war, and it won't be a warning any more<MV>the prophecy will have come true.
Indeed. And we must do everything in our power to stop it. Your mission to Ingenia is a vital one. Our hopes go with you.
So, ready for your first trip to Ingenia<FH>
Yep<FG> I can't wait<FG> I've read so much about it<FG>
Well, as I mentioned, you need to go through the forest to get there. And it's not just any old forest...
The route runs through an area called the Wildwood. It's easy to get lost there, and even easier to get attacked by monsters.
Mmm... Sounds lovely...
Well, it wouldn't have been a few years ago, but luckily, the Ingenians have built a path that skirts the worst of it.
So it shouldn't be too horrible a trip, but you should still make sure you're ready for anything. You never know...
Right, here we all are. I think it's safe to say we should expect the worst<MV>tricks, traps...the whole lot...
And, of course, monsters<MV>lots of them. This is going to be harder than anything we've faced before. Are you sure you're ready<FH>
Sure. Any excuse.
Ha ha<FG> I'm glad you're on our side now, that's all I can say<FG> Happy to have you along<FG>
Carver and Terry join the party<FG>
Well, I'm ready to leave this forest behind if you are. The city should be just a short walk north of here.
Ingenia at last... Time to find out what the Queen has been up to...and what else she might be plotting...
Let's move.
...Forgive me. I accused you of being traitors, and refused to listen when you tried to explain. You have every right to despise me.
Than I've ever been for anything<FG> The High King can throw whatever he likes at us<MV>we can handle it<FG>
As I'll ever be<FG> We'll make it to that throne room if it's the last thing we do<FG>
Hm. That's the spirit. Then it's time...
Alright. Well, make the necessary preparations and let me know when you're done.
Thanks so much for taking back the city<FG> I thought we'd never be able to come home again<FG>
I'm sure you must have defeated a lot of monsters in the process of reclaiming the city. Don't forget to report the numbers to me<FG>
The Ingenians will be in the middle of retaking their capital. Hardly the time for a friendly exchange of barrier-related information...
Then we'll just have to get stuck in and help them out<FG> That'll make things quicker anyway.
And it might put Her Majesty in more of a mood to help us...
Alright, sounds like we have a plan<FG> Let's head for Ingenia<FG>
Life in the encampment was surprisingly bearable, but nothing beats being back behind the counter of the Quester's Rest<FG>
Your heroic actions have helped deliver the citizens of Accordia from evil. Your path is a virtuous one indeed.
I wonder what would have happened to us all if you weren't here to save us... Well, anyway, it's a good thing you were. Thank you<FG>
You're so brave, going up against the monsters like that<FG> I saw everything<FG> You really were a sight to behold<FG>
Well, that's Ingenia saved, and a magic stone retrieved<FG> And all thanks to me<FG>
Now we can finally get back to the Pinnacle<FG> We'll be counting on you, Healix<FG>
Fear not, comrades<FG> It is only a matter of slime until that barrier is no more<FG>
So that's the Black Manse... It was supposed to have been destroyed a thousand years ago...but there it is...
And if he has the power to bring back the Manse...he has the power to destroy the world again...
What do you mean ‘again’<FH> He failed last time, didn't he<FH> And how could a castle destroy the world anyway<FH>
He failed to put an end to this world...but he did destroy another<MV>its twin...
With a single blast from the Black Manse's most formidable weapon...the Dreadbolt...
My father told me of this<MV>of a twin world that was plunged into darkness during the War of Kings and lost to us forever.
Wait, wait, wait<FG> This can't be true<FG> How could we never have heard about it<FH>
And how could there possibly be a weapon that powerful<FH> This is madness<FG>
It works by channelling all the darkness and hatred in the world into a single beam. It's a truly horrifying device...
And there's only one way to stop it<MV>we have to defeat Fractos before the Black Manse has the chance to build up enough power.
He's up there somewhere...we just have to find a way to reach him...
There's no need to go that way at the moment. Come on, we've got things to do<MV>let's not waste time with detours.
Wassat<FH> Which way did 'e go<FH> Off to the north-west there, I fink. Blimey, there's kids playin' over that way<MV>I 'ope they're okay...
Meena casts Woosh on the fan, and blows the door wide open<FG>
Hmph. Our orders are to retrieve the legendary weapon. We cannot return to the Great Divide empty-handed.
NOT USED
NOT USED
Wow, I haven't seen a wind-powered door before<FG> We never would have worked that out without you<FG> Well done, Meena<FG>
That mark on your arm... Does that really mean Fractos is your ancestor<FH>
I'm afraid so... All his descendants bear it... It's our punishment for his having succumbed to the power of darkness...
So he's<MV>what<MV>your great-great-great-great grandad or something like that<FH>
That's right. And he damned us all. He knew that if he began practising the dark arts, we would suffer...and it still didn't stop him...
It's more than just a mark...it's a curse... Many of my ancestors died before their time because of it...and those who didn't were reviled...
Slowly, one by one, our entire line died out... Until eventually, I was the only one left...
And that's what's driven me all these years<MV>the need to finally rid my family of the shame and suffering he condemned us to...
But to do that, I had to find him. I couldn't put an end to his evil otherwise...
And he was right there all along. It's kind of ironic when you think about it...
Hm. Not as ironic as two of my closest allies turning out to be Unos's direct descendants. That must have made Fractos laugh...
You have cleared the way onward, you say<FH> Goddess bless you<FG> Now I can be on my way<FG>
Well, well, well, what have we here<FH> You look like a born fighter<FG> You might even have what it takes to wield one of my little beauties...
Hurr hurr hurr<FG> Come here<FG> Fight Donk<FG>
You hear the growling of a great wild beast on the other side... Go through the gate<FH>
You hear a creepy cackle and the clacking of cloven hooves on the other side... Go through the gate<FH>
You hear the slow scraping of someone sharpening steel, and chuckling demonically all the while... Go through the gate<FH>
You hear the ponderous plodding of a portly presence on the other side... Go through the gate<FH>
...Me<FH> I'm just a humble blacksmith. I teach armourers the tricks of the trade so they can make new weapons to sell in their stores.
And it's about time I was on my way. I'm travelling all around the world, you see, brushing up on the secrets of smithing.
If you catch sight of me out on your travels, come and say hello<FG> Right then, I'm off. See you around, <EK>00lad<EL>00lass<EM>00.
Gragwort holds the Trinity Stone aloft<FG>
A pazuzu, a belial and the mighty Atlas appear<FG>
Do you really think we are<FH> Could we really be the twins from the prophecy<FH> Even if we are, we still don't know how to beat Fractos...
Just because you're descended from Unos, that doesn't mean we're going to leave you to sort everything out. We'll find a way together.
Oh, umm... I'm just glad that I could be of help... Well, shall we see what's on the other side<FH>
Wow... I've got no clue what that thing is, but I'm guessing it's not good. Any idea how we're going to get past it<FH>
...Ah, I comprehend<FG> This is accumulation of grievances of dearly departed in nearby graveyard, entrapped in incorrect world<FG>
O mild and merciful Goddess<FG> Take pity on suffering souls, and allow to rest easily in hereafter<FG>
Kiryl's prayer dispels the barrier<FG>
That was amazing, Kiryl<FG> All that darkness disappeared in the blink of an eye<FG>
All is thanks to Goddess. Anguished spirits are now at peace. Come, let us to proceed inwards.
Hm. Hm hm hm<FG> Fractos has made fools of all of us. Oh, how we danced in the palm of his hand<FG>
Cesar, please<FG> Now's not the time to get angry and give up<FG> We need to work out a plan<FG>
You misunderstand me. I am not giving up. I am encouraged. Defeating Fractos won't just save our world<MV>it will avenge my father.
And besides, we have the descendants of Unos himself fighting beside us now. How can we possibly lose<FH>
Hmm... I'm not sure that makes any difference, you know... I feel exactly the same as I did before we found all that stuff out...
Hm. Then carry on exactly as you always have. We have proven our strength time and again. Together, we will end this.
That's strange<MV>I'm sure this path was blocked by rocks the last time we were here. I wonder when they were cleared away<FH>
No Man's Land is full of powerful monsters. Maybe one of them smashed a way through...
If we could knock that tree over, we might be able to use it as a bridge to get to the other side of the canyon...
You want it laid low<FH> Your wish is my command, kiddo<FG> It ain't gonna know what hit it<FG>
Here it comes<FG> Three, two, one...OOSH<FG>
Carver's Knuckle Sandwich sends the tree crashing to the ground<FG>
So we're twins... The twins from the prophecy, right<FH> I don't know about you, but I don't feel like I have any special powers or anything...
Me neither... And it's not like I know what we're supposed to do now, either...
Maybe we shouldn't worry about it for now. We just have to knuckle down and do what we can, right<FH>
Right. Which means finding a way into the Black Manse. Let's get to work<FG>
Alriiight<FG> Nice work, Carver<FG> I can't believe you took down a tree that big with a single punch<FG>
You better believe it, baby<FG> Alright, let's go see what's on the other side<FG>
Right, enough chat. The Beastlands await<FG>
The entrance to the Tomb of the Sun is up on that plateau.
Alright then<FG> Let's get up there<FG>
Alena and Kiryl join the party<FG>
A cat jumps out of the well<FG>
This is my first trip to Harba in a while, and business is far from booming, I have to say. It's a lot quieter than usual...
What's that<FH> The Dunisians attacked the town<FG><FH> No wonder no one's out and about<FG> M-Maybe I should...come back another time...
Isn't the sea here in Harba a beauty to behold<FH> I can feel my worries just washing away<FG>
Can we go home now, Grandad<FH> I'm not angry with you for eating my lunch any more, I promise<FG>
How many times, child<FG><FH> I did NOT eat it<FG> Someone must have been pretending to be me<MV>it's the only answer<FG>
Hiss... Let me out of here, and I'll ssslice you up real nice...
Clank...
Oi, what you lookin' at<FH> You startin' or somefink<FH>
A motley crew of mean-looking monsters glowers from behind the bars...
By the hokey, would ye look at the size o' them snowballs<FG> An' all perched precariously at the top o' steep, snowy slopes...
Heh. Almost as if somebody wanted us to send 'em rollin' down onto the critters below, huh<FH>
Now here's a face I have not seen before. Well met, friend<FG> I am a scion of one of the most ancient and honourable houses of Accordia.
Ah, you again. I am hearing great things about your progress. But you still have a way to go until you are as eminent as I<FG>
Hmm... You appear a little more...gallant than when last we met. Not nearly as heroic as myself, of course.
It seems you are becoming quite the well-known knight<FG> If your fame continues to grow, I may even have to learn your name<FG>
Ah, my good friend <F4><I0>01<FG> Oft have I heard your name on the lips of the townspeople of late. Your fame is growing<FG>
<F4><I0>01<FG> The tales of your deeds grow ever more marvellous<FG> May I offer you my heartiest congratulations<FG>
<F4><I0>01... It seems there is not a man, woman or child in Accordia who does not know that name... But I may outshine you yet<FG>
<F4><I0>01... When first we met, I could scarcely have foreseen the heights to which your fame has soared. ...You have bested me.
Ah, <EK>00Lord<EL>00Lady<EM>00 <F4><I0>01. ...Hm<FH> Do you find the title strange<FH> 'Tis the fitting form of address for a hero such as yourself<FG>
<EK>00Lord<EL>00Lady<EM>00 <F4><I0>01<FG> 'Tis an honour and a privilege to have met such an illustrious hero as yourself<FG>
Finally made it, eh<FH> Come on, then<MV>let's get cracking.
The rules of this trial are so simple, any idiot could understand them. See these bad 'uns<FH> You've to batter 'em. Every last one.
If you can do that, I'll let you into a special corner of the Frosty Foothills where you can get your hands on some right tasty bits of kit.
Well<FH> What are you waiting for<FH> This trial won't pass itself, you know<FG>
Ooh, get you<FG> Not a bad little performance<FG> Alright, a deal's a deal<MV>I'll open up that bit of the Frosty Foothills for you.
You go and get your result rubber-stamped by the questmistress, and I'll see about bringing down that barrier.
No, no<FG> I'm not going back, not going back<FG> I still have tricks to play, tricks to play<FG>
Well, you'll be enjoying the hospitality of her dungeons again if we don't get moving. Come on, let's get outside<FG>
He's right. We all understand how you feel, but please<MV>try to keep a cool head.
Grr... Fine. I will be a picture of princely restraint...
Are you ready to get going<FH> Make sure you're properly prepared before we set off<MV>anything could happen out there<FG>
The Beastlands sound really scary... (quiver) B-B-But never fear<FG> I'm b-b-brave enough for b-b-both of us<FG>
The King of Al-Khazam has always been a just and merciful ruler. He would never invade his neighbours without good reason...
Come along, we can't hang around here forever. As soon as you're ready, let's head through that gate and on to the Beastlands.
Fancy Meena and Maya windin' up here in yer world an' all<FG> What in the world could it mean<FH> Yerra, 'tis a puzzle, so it is...
The Beastlands sound absolutely horrible. I'll come along if I have to, but if any of those monsters so much as scratch me, I'll scream<FG>
The Beastlands sound brilliant<FG> Aooo<FG> I can't wait to see what a place completely run by monsters is like<FG>
Three whole countries full of wild, warring monsters, huh<FH> Sounds like my kinda party.
The King of Al-Khazam took over two kingdoms at once<FH> Jeez, I can't even pat my head and rub my belly at the same time<FG> Heh<FG>
There are no casinos in this world, it seems. Thank the Goddess<MV>that means my sister won't be able to gamble all our money away.
Are there really no casinos in this world<FH> Oh, Goddess... I think I'm going to cry...
The Beastlands are home to some of the most formidable monsters in the Seven Realms. Be on your guard.
If the monsters keep marching on Ingenia, we'll have no choice but to fight them. It'll be like the War of Kings all over again<FG>
Is there really no way this battle can be avoided<FH> Do we really have to fight<FH>
If the monsters keep trying to push into Ingenia, it'll lead to a war like nothing we've seen before...
Gah<FG> Why is the King of Al-Khazam doing this<FG><FH>
Everyone in Accordia seems really wobbly... (quiver) You don't think there's gooing to be another gooreat war, do you<FH>
Don't waste my time with idle chit-chat. We need to prepare for battle and make for the Great Divide without delay.
The King of Al-Khazam is a wise and merciful ruler. It's completely out of character for him to invade his neighbours on a whim.
By the hokey, this world's in a quare auld pickle, and no mistake<FG> Ye'd best be sure to double-check yer gear before we head out<FG>
Do you really think this is the time to be chatting<FH> Stop dawdling and get ready for battle, will you<FH>
Grrr... Everyone in town's so tense. It's setting my teeth right on edge<FG>
Do I have to remind you that there's an army headed our way<FH> Less talk, more action<FG>
Seems the King of Al-Khazam ain't none too keen on keepin' the peace in this world<MV>he's fixin' to rip it to pieces far as I can see<FG>
The cards tell me there are dark days ahead... We must go to the Great Divide without delay<FG>
Is it really true<FH> Is an army of monsters marching on Ingenia<FH> I do hope Her Majesty is okay...
The King of Harba's last wish was for us to go to Mt Neverest and bring back that legendary weapon. We can't let him down<FG>
The King of Harba gave us our orders...and I'm not going to let him down<FG> Alriiight<FG> Mt Neverest, here we come<FG>
Everyone in Harba loved the King... He was so kind, and just, and gooracious... (sniff)
And now they'll never get to see him ever again... (slurp) It's just snot fair...
The King of Harba was a shining example to all those who would rule. I must strive to follow in his footsteps...
We've been given an important mission<MV>one on which the fate of this world may very well depend. So what say we get to work<FH>
I wonder what the craic is with this legendary weapon. Is it a sword<FH> A spear<FH> ...An abacus<FG><FH> Oh, that'd be deadly, that would<FG>
I feel absolutely awful about what happened to the King. But this is no time to be moping around<FG> We've got to find that weapon<FG>
Grrr... That rotten drakulard... I'm gonna get him back if it's the last thing I do<FG>
They don't call weapons ‘legendary’ for nothing. This thing must be special...
I been thinkin'<MV>if this weapon's got what it takes to bring down that mountain of a critter, it's gotta be pretty big itself, right<FH>
Which means bringin' it down from the top o' Mt Neverest is gonna be a big ask...
I see an icy peak surrounded by a snowfield... I see great, swirling blizzards... Be sure to wrap up warm, won't you<FH>
It was an awful-awful thing that happened, but we have to stop moping and look ahead. Let's grab this weapon and get our revenge<FG>
Where are you going<FH> This is no time for sightseeing<FG>
Ma'am<FG> A message from the Queen of Ingenia<FG>
She would like to speak with you about the great floating castle that has appeared in the sky<FG>
Well now, isn't that a coincidence. She might just know something. Alright<MV>to Ingenia<FG>

NOT USED
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Aberrant Estate<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Night Club<FG>
I am glad to see you well. I was worried for your safety when I heard that the Pinnacle had collapsed.
Tell me everything that happened in Accordia. Then we will speak of the Black Manse...
...So Fractos has grown powerful enough to bring the Black Manse back to our world<FH>
Then time is of the essence. I called you here to tell you how you might gain access to Fractos's stronghold.
You must go via the other world. The one he laid waste to all those years ago. There is a teleportal in Unos's palace there.
When the two brothers each ruled over their own worlds, they would use it to travel between them.
So if we go to this other world and use the teleportal in Unos's palace, we'll be able to jump straight into the Black Manse<FH>
It's not quite that simple. After the Dreadbolt destroyed his world, Unos sealed it away, hoping to trap Fractos and the Black Manse.
So our problem will be getting to the other world in the first place.
You are well informed. But there is something you do not know. Unos created a secret portal to the other world during his final days here.
So there is a way<FG>
There is. No one knows quite why he created it, but he is said to have used it several times before finally succumbing to his injuries.
It is hidden in Dunisia. In the Tomb of the Sun, to be precise. Were you aware of its existence, Cesar<FH>
I was not. But I could well believe it<MV>the ruins hide many mysteries.
Alllright then<FG> Looks like we're heading for the Tomb of the Sun<FG>
Thank you, Your Majesty<FG> We'll find the way to the other world, I promise<FG>
I am sure you will. But be careful<MV>I do not know what has become of that ruined world, or what dangers may await you...

<F4><I0>01 receives maps to the Kings' Combat Zone and Port-au-Pain<FG>

<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Lair of the Dark Master<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Twin Sovereigns' Seat<FG>
Eek<FG> Don't scare me like that, scare me like that<FG> If there's something you want, ask from in front of the counter, in front of the counter<FG>

<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Tower of Tribulations<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Foul Fortress<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Metal Maze<FG>
Humans... Can it really be<FH> Have you come here from the other world<FH> The world that yet lives<FH>
I was once a servant to Unos... The Dreadbolt cursed me to wander this dead world as a spirit, never to know rest...
Why have you come to these forsaken lands<FH>
Fractos has returned. He has corrupted the Cup of Kings, and is plotting to destroy our world.
We need to find a way into the Black Manse so that we can stop him.
So that is why Fractos and his palace have vanished...
We seek a portal that leads to the Manse. We were told it was to be found in Unos's palace.
Do you know of it<FH>
Unos's palace<FH> I am afraid it fell from the sky a thousand long years ago... It lies now in pieces...
Oh no... So does that mean the teleportal's gone too<FH>
I cannot say for certain... The ruins lie in the wilds to the north of here. Perhaps you will find what you seek there...
Alright, we'll go and see what we can find. Thanks<FG>
There are other cursed souls like myself who still wander this world. I will ask them to lend you their aid<MV>seek them out<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Liquid Metal Maze<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to the Metal King Maze<FG>
Ah<FG> And you are wearing my ring<FG> Truly, this is an honour beyond compare<FG>
Underssstood, Your Highnesss<FG> We live to ssserve<FG>
‘Continue east to reach the Great Divide. Beware of falling rocks<FG>’
‘Follow the path downhill to reach the Great Divide. Follow the path uphill to reach Accordia. Hairpin bends ahead<FG>’
Oh, goodness<FG> You must be the people from the other world I've heard about<FG> Don't worry, the others have told me everything.
Were you one of Unos's servants too<FH>
Servant indeed<FG> Ooh, you little scamp<FG> I was his nanny<FG> I looked after the little angel from the day he was born...
He and his brother were inseparable once, you know... Even as grown-ups, they were always zipping back and forth visiting one another...
But then...Fractos took a turn for the evil, and poor Unos was forced to fight him for the greater good... Oh, it breaks my heart...
Oh, but listen to me nattering on about the past<FG> You need to get on and find the remains of the palace...
I'm afraid so. We were told we could find them in the wilds to the north.
That's right, dear. Head all the way north through these woods and you'll find them. Ooh, but be careful of all the horrible monsters<FG>
‘Follow the path east to reach the Great Divide.’
‘Follow the path straight on to reach Mt Neverest.’
Who's there<FH> Ah. You must be the travellers seeking the ruins of Unos's palace...
